panels.label: 佩戴展示
panels.copy_purpose: 符合帽型的自然佩戴与头部比例
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact hat correctly and naturally worn by one adult model without changing crown, brim, fit, or visible branding.
panels.composition_en: Use the minimum head-and-shoulders crop, show the complete hat silhouette, and keep the left side calm.
panels.lighting_en: Soft portrait daylight revealing fabric and shape.

panels.label: 帽型轮廓
panels.copy_purpose: 帽冠、帽檐、帽围和整体比例
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a clean three-quarter product view preserving the exact crown height, brim curve, panels, fit structure, and proportions.
panels.composition_en: Keep the complete hat in the upper-middle and reserve the lower area.
panels.lighting_en: Large soft light with precise silhouette definition.

panels.label: 面料工艺
panels.copy_purpose: 完整帽型中突出面料、编织、缝线、调节结构和品牌元素
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact complete hat in a detail-led product photograph, using angle and light to reveal fabric, weave, seams, edge finish, adjustment hardware, and visible brand elements.
panels.composition_en: Keep the complete crown and brim silhouette inside frame; make defining details readable on the left and reserve the upper-right.
panels.lighting_en: Raking daylight with realistic fiber and stitching texture.

panels.label: 生活场景
panels.copy_purpose: 符合帽型用途的城市或户外场景
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact hat in a believable category-appropriate urban or outdoor lifestyle moment, still fully recognizable.
panels.backdrop_en: Sparse premium environment appropriate to the observed hat type.
panels.composition_en: Keep the worn hat and model on the lower-right and preserve the upper-left.

panels.label: 产品主视觉
panels.copy_purpose: 完整帽型与品牌识别的静物广告主视觉
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a premium isolated hero advertisement of the exact complete hat on a correctly scaled neutral support.
panels.composition_en: Place the complete hat slightly left and reserve a quiet lower-right.
panels.lighting_en: Controlled campaign light defining crown, brim, and texture.
